subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `yieldToolResult(...)` plus `canYield: true` and sequential execution as the Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned external interactions?
rationale: The code is a coherent implementation, but the new helper, result control, scheduling declaration, and Tool Search exception define a durable external plugin contract that source review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt the narrow contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in public API with its documented sequential-execution requirement and direct catalog visibility for yield-capable tools.

options.title: Narrow or defer the surface
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers choose a different API boundary or defer the capability to a broader interaction design.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in public API with its documented sequential-execution requirement and direct catalog visibility for yield-capable tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically identifies this person as the best available owner for the existing session-yield lifecycle contract.
